en: Self-hosted runner: Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`: its prefix can now end in `oat02-` as well as `oat01-`. Update proxy rules and log scrubbers that match `oat01-`, and mask the whole value
zh: 自托管运行器：变更 `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`：其前缀现在除 `oat01-` 外还可以以 `oat02-` 结尾。请更新匹配 `oat01-` 的代理规则和日志脱敏规则，并对整个值进行掩码
